changes: Adds long-session RAM-aware thumbnail/cache pressure controls and separates high-concurrency NNTP preview work from bounded native image decoding.
Treats explicit deep page jumps as hard navigation boundaries so Continuous mode cannot immediately compete with the destination page.
Uses a persistent WIC-first native thumbnail engine with fallback decoding, size-aware scheduling, selective 2-3 lane multipart acceleration, and direct persistent-cache hints.
Suppresses genuinely tiny source images from visual gallery/media results with persistent negative caching so blurry thumbnail-of-thumbnail posts do not consume repeated work.

Keeps native thumbnail workers alive, maintains an in-RAM thumbnail/suppression catalog, snapshots gallery geometry once per demand frame, and cautiously warms the first images of the next Continuous page.
Uses a generation-aware O(1) thumbnail DOM registry, native blank-output validation, normal Chromium asynchronous paint/decode, and a bounded thumbnail-token LRU.
Expands Diagnostics with native decode, multipart lane, RAM catalog, worker reuse, prewarm, DOM registry, blank rejection, and token-cache telemetry.
regression_guards: v3.6.7 Browsing Pipeline & Long-Scroll Performance remains preserved.
v3.6.6 Adaptive Preview Connection Scaling remains preserved.
v3.6.5 Windows Taskbar Identity Reliability remains preserved.
v3.6.4 Newsgroup Package Browser & Binary Reconstruction remains preserved.
Private SAB downloads, Smart Import, Automation, Discover/TMDB, provider state, and Metadata Server v0.3.3 compatibility remain unchanged.
name: Image Browsing Performance & Gallery Quality
